description: This is a PHP test class (I18NTranslationAPITest) for the I18NTranslationAPI, focusing on API testing within the OrangeHRM system. It includes test methods for API endpoints related to internationalization translation management, such as retrieving all translations, creating, and deleting translations, along with corresponding validation rule tests.

classes.name: I18NTranslationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the I18NTranslationAPI, testing GET and CRUD operation behaviors within the OrangeHRM API testing framework.
